metadata.description: Session lifecycle for Claude Code: hand off, pick up, capture, and distill work so every session starts where the last one ended.

plugins.name: absorb
plugins.description: Distill what a session taught (intent, decisions, domain knowledge, preferences) into memory files that every future session loads.

plugins.name: close
plugins.description: End-of-session ritual: handoff when work is unfinished, memory update, session summary, and an optional notification you configure.

plugins.name: explore
plugins.description: Map a codebase's structure (symbols with line ranges) before reading, then read only the symbols that matter, with a bundled outline script.

plugins.name: grab
plugins.description: Copy the latest command, URL, or full reply from the current Claude Code session straight to the system clipboard.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write a HANDOFF.md at session end that captures state, diff-invisible context, verify commands, and one specific next step, indexed for /pickup.

plugins.name: maintain
plugins.description: Audit a Claude Code setup (MCP health, plugin token cost, sync conflicts, settings, memory size, usage, hooks) and fix only what you approve.

plugins.name: meet
plugins.description: Research a new collaborator or client once (web, your projects, your GitHub) and save a contact memory file future sessions reuse.

plugins.name: pickup
plugins.description: Start a session from a HANDOFF.md: find it, re-run its verify commands, load the key files, and show the next action; falls back to git history.

plugins.name: share-prompt
plugins.description: Send a coworker a paste-ready prompt through your clipboard, a secret gist, your own command, or LibreWhatsApp /push.

plugins.name: todo
plugins.description: Capture a TODO into the project's TODO.md mid-session without breaking flow, and triage the list when it grows.
